result.topic_en: Calculations on conformal (orthogonality / Cauchy–Riemann type) conditions for a map with components x, y, a, b in variables α, β (or p, q), followed by a transformation of a Dirichlet-type integral and a Taylor expansion of x about a point.
result.transcription:
$\frac{\partial x}{\partial\alpha}\frac{\partial x}{\partial p}+\frac{\partial y}{\partial\alpha}\frac{\partial y}{\partial p}\cdots=0$ | $\left(\frac{\partial x}{\partial\alpha}+\frac{\partial y}{\partial\alpha}i\right)\left(\frac{\partial x}{\partial p}-\frac{\partial y}{\partial p}i\right)+\left(\frac{\partial a}{\partial\alpha}+\frac{\partial b}{\partial\alpha}i\right)\left(\frac{\partial a}{\partial p}-\frac{\partial b}{\partial p}i\right)=0$
$\frac{\partial x}{\partial p}\frac{\partial x}{\partial p}+\frac{\partial y}{\partial p}\frac{\partial y}{\partial p}\cdots=0$
$\frac{\frac{\partial x}{\partial p}-\frac{\partial y}{\partial p}i}{\frac{\partial a}{\partial p}-\frac{\partial b}{\partial p}i}=\frac{\frac{\partial x}{\partial q}-\frac{\partial y}{\partial q}i}{\frac{\partial a}{\partial q}-\frac{\partial b}{\partial q}i}=\mathfrak{L}+\mathfrak{M}i$
$\left(\frac{\partial a}{\partial p}-\frac{\partial b}{\partial p}i\right)\left(\frac{\partial a}{\partial q}+\frac{\partial b}{\partial q}i\right)=(\mathfrak{L}\mathfrak{L}+\mathfrak{M}\mathfrak{M})\left(\frac{\partial x}{\partial p}-\frac{\partial y}{\partial p}i\right)\left(\frac{\partial x}{\partial q}+\frac{\partial y}{\partial q}i\right)$
$\left(\frac{\partial a}{\partial p}\frac{\partial a}{\partial q}+\frac{\partial b}{\partial p}\frac{\partial b}{\partial q}\cdots\right)=0$ | $\frac{\partial x}{\partial p}\frac{\partial x}{\partial q}+\frac{\partial y}{\partial p}\frac{\partial y}{\partial q}=0$

$\frac{\partial^2 u}{[-\partial\alpha\partial\varphi-]}-\frac{\partial^2 u}{\partial q\partial\beta}=$
$\int\frac{\partial u}{\partial p}\,dS=\int\frac{\partial u}{r\partial r}\,r\left(\left(\frac{\partial x}{\partial\alpha}\right)^2+\left(\frac{\partial y}{\partial\alpha}\right)^2+\left(\frac{\partial a}{\partial\alpha}\right)^2+\left(\frac{\partial b}{\partial\alpha}\right)^2\right)\partial\varphi\,\partial\alpha\,\partial\beta$
[-$\int\left(\frac{\partial^2 u}{\partial x^2}+\frac{\partial^2 u}{\partial y^2}\right)\left(\frac{\partial^2 u}{\partial x\partial r}-\frac{\partial^2 u}{\partial q\partial r}\right)r\,\partial\varphi\left(\frac{\partial x}{\partial\alpha}^2\cdots\right)\partial\alpha\,\partial\beta$-]
$\int\left(\frac{\partial u}{\partial p}^2-\frac{\partial u}{\partial q}^2\right)\left(\left(\frac{\partial x}{\partial\alpha}\right)^2+\left(\frac{\partial y}{\partial\alpha}\right)^2\cdots\right)+\left(\left(\frac{\partial u}{\partial\alpha}\right)^2+\left(\frac{\partial u}{\partial\beta}\right)^2\right)\left(\left(\frac{\partial x}{\partial p}\right)^2+\left(\frac{\partial y}{\partial p}\right)^2\cdots\right)\partial p\,\partial q$[?]

[-$\left(\frac{\partial\, r\frac{\partial u}{\partial r}}{r\partial r}+\frac{\partial\frac{1}{r}\frac{\partial u}{\partial\varphi}}{\partial\varphi}\right)\left(\left(\frac{\partial x}{\partial\alpha}\right)^2+\left(\frac{\partial y}{\partial\alpha}\right)^2\cdots\right)+\left(\frac{\partial^2 u}{\partial\alpha^2}+\frac{\partial^2 u}{\partial\beta^2}\right)r\left(\left(\frac{\partial x}{\partial r}\right)^2\cdots\right)$
$+\frac{\partial u}{\partial\alpha}\frac{\partial}{\partial\alpha}\left(\frac{\partial x}{\partial r}^2-\frac{\partial y}{\partial r}\cdots\right)$-]

$x=x_0+\frac{\partial x}{\partial p}p+\frac{\partial x}{\partial q}q$
$\left(\frac{\partial^2 u}{\partial p^2}+\frac{\partial^2 u}{\partial q^2}\right)\left[\left(\frac{\partial x}{\partial\alpha}+\frac{\partial^2 x}{\partial p\partial\alpha}p+\frac{\partial^2 x}{\partial q\partial\alpha}q\right)^2\cdots\right]$
$+\frac{\partial u}{\partial p}\left[2\frac{\partial^2 x}{\partial\alpha\partial p}\left(\frac{\partial x}{\partial\alpha}+\frac{\partial^2 x}{\partial p\partial\alpha}p+\frac{\partial^2 x}{\partial q\partial\alpha}q\right)\cdots\right]$
$+\frac{\partial u}{\partial q}\left[2\frac{\partial^2 x}{\partial\alpha\partial q}\left(\frac{\partial x}{\partial\alpha}+\frac{\partial^2 x}{\partial p\partial\alpha}p+\frac{\partial^2 x}{\partial q\partial\alpha}q\right)\cdots\right]$
$+\left(\frac{\partial^2 u}{\partial\alpha^2}+\frac{\partial^2 u}{\partial\beta^2}\right)(A\cos\varphi+B\sin\varphi)$[?]
$-\frac{\partial u}{\partial r}\cdots\frac{\partial^2 x}{\partial p\partial\alpha}\cdots\Big)r+\frac{\partial u}{\partial\beta}\left(2\frac{\partial x}{\partial p}\frac{\partial^2 x}{\partial p\partial\beta}\right)=A\cos\varphi+B\sin\varphi$[?]

methods.what: Orthogonality conditions written in complex form for a map (x,y,a,b)
methods.quote: $\left(\frac{\partial x}{\partial\alpha}+\frac{\partial y}{\partial\alpha}i\right)\left(\frac{\partial x}{\partial p}-\frac{\partial y}{\partial p}i\right)+\left(\frac{\partial a}{\partial\alpha}+\frac{\partial b}{\partial\alpha}i\right)\left(\frac{\partial a}{\partial p}-\frac{\partial b}{\partial p}i\right)=0$

methods.what: Equal complex ratio of derivatives with respect to p and q (conformality condition)
methods.quote: $\frac{\frac{\partial x}{\partial p}-\frac{\partial y}{\partial p}i}{\frac{\partial a}{\partial p}-\frac{\partial b}{\partial p}i}=\frac{\frac{\partial x}{\partial q}-\frac{\partial y}{\partial q}i}{\frac{\partial a}{\partial q}-\frac{\partial b}{\partial q}i}=\mathfrak{L}+\mathfrak{M}i$

methods.what: Derived relation between products of derivatives
methods.quote: $\left(\frac{\partial a}{\partial p}-\frac{\partial b}{\partial p}i\right)\left(\frac{\partial a}{\partial q}+\frac{\partial b}{\partial q}i\right)=(\mathfrak{L}\mathfrak{L}+\mathfrak{M}\mathfrak{M})\left(\frac{\partial x}{\partial p}-\frac{\partial y}{\partial p}i\right)\left(\frac{\partial x}{\partial q}+\frac{\partial y}{\partial q}i\right)$
